items.label: Jan to Apr, year on year
H2, year on year
items.note: Two city distributors and key stores

items.title: What happened
items.text: I moved three cities in northern Jiangsu to a new distributor. Jan to Apr shipments fell 38%, and the area hit 81.3% of target.

items.title: Where I went wrong
items.text: I checked their money, not their reach: 64 stores against the old dealer's 150.

items.title: Why it took till May
items.text: I waited two months to see if they would catch up, instead of cutting losses.

items.title: What I changed
items.text: Took it back in May: two city distributors plus direct supply to key stores. H2 was up 6%.

notes: This was my misjudgment, not the market. I switched because the old dealer paid slowly and the new distributor had more capital, but I never checked their store coverage one by one: 64 stores against 150. Shipments fell 38% from January to April, and I waited two more months before acting. Since taking it back in May with two city distributors and direct supply to key stores, the second half was up 6% on last year. From now on I check store coverage before anything else when changing a distributor.
